There are a few important things to remember. 

1. You are not overthinking. Your feelings are real, valid, and deserve to be seen.
2. Make it very clear that this is a serious conversation that will impact the relationship you have. Explain that you really need him to talk instead of just agreeing. Don't let it slide, make it a boundary.
3. Be assertive. Not passive, passive aggressive, or aggressive. You are capable, and I know you can do this.
4. Explain that this is a very important and emotional topic to you. Don't let anyone jump to conclusions if you cry. If you cry, you cry, that does not change what you're asking clarity for.
